content: Fixed in commit 929f065. Two-part fix: (1) PID-match self-probe guard in connectivity.py — when sovereign-sse probes itself, skip HTTP round-trip since the tool response proves liveness. (2) Converted _do_connectivity_status to async with asyncio.run_in_executor so urllib probes run in thread pool, not blocking the event loop. Both sse and bridge now report clean.
resolved_from: connectivity_status reports sse + bridge as DEGRADED with http_error=socket:time
